media.description: Every media file used by any clip. Clips refer to these by id and never embed paths.

schema_version.description: The schema this document was written with; readers migrate older versions and refuse newer ones.

value.description: The value when there are no keys.

Background.description: The project background (TL-19): shown behind every layer, so only where the layers leave the canvas uncovered.

blur.description: Blur strength 0..=100 (50 = the default look); used by `Blur`.

colour.description: sRGB 8-bit red, green, blue; used by `Colour`.

BackgroundMode.description: How the empty part of the canvas is filled.

oneOf.description: The bottom-most picture of the frame, scaled to fill the canvas and blurred by `Background::blur`.

audio.description: Volume and fades (round 16, schema 6). The plain clip is the default and is not written.

duration.description: Length on the timeline (source length is `duration * speed`).

link.description:
Clips sharing a link edit as one (TL-05, `docs/features/timeline-ops.md`): the picture and the sound of one import. `None` = alone.
Only the editing layer acts on it; evaluation and export ignore it. Absent in files made before linking existed.

source_in.description: Where in the source media the clip starts.

start.description: Where the clip starts on the sequence timeline.

transform.description: Position, scale, rotation, crop, flip, opacity and fit (M2-003). The identity is the default and is not written.

ClipAudio.description: Linear gain, fade in and fade out of one clip. `Default` is the plain clip (full level, no fades) and is not written.

fade_in.description: Length of the rise from silence at the clip's start, in ticks (`>= 0`). Not written when 0.

fade_out.description: Length of the fall to silence at the clip's end, in ticks (`>= 0`). Not written when 0.

volume.description: Linear gain, `0..=MAX_VOLUME` (shown as 0-200%). 1 = as recorded; 0 = muted. Not written when 1.

ClipTransform.description: Position, scale, rotation, anchor, crop, flip, opacity and fit of one clip. `Default` is the identity.

anchor_x.description: The point rotation, scale and flip pivot on, as an offset from the picture centre in picture widths / heights.

crop_left.description: Fraction of the source picture removed from each edge, `0..1`; `left + right < 1` and `top + bottom < 1`.

position_x.description: Offset of the anchor from the canvas centre, in canvas widths (+ right). 0 = centred.

scale_x.description: 1 = the size `fit` gives. Must be > 0 (flip is separate).

oneOf.description: Keeps this key's value until the next key (a step).

Fit.description: How the picture is first sized into the canvas, before scale applies.

oneOf.description: Whole picture visible, bars where the shapes differ (the M1 behaviour).
Picture covers the canvas, the overflow is cut off.
Picture is stretched to the canvas shape.

easing.description: Shape of the segment from this key to the next (ignored on the last key).

t.description: Clip-relative time (0 = the clip's first tick on the timeline).

Marker.description: A point on the sequence's timeline (ticks, `>= 0`) with a name and an optional colour.

name.description: 0-120 characters, no surrounding spaces. Empty is allowed (an unnamed marker).

MarkerKind.description: A plain marker (a flag on the ruler) or a chapter (also exported as a chapter mark).

MediaRef.description: A source file as the project knows it. The bytes live outside the project; `uri` is resolved by the host.

duration.description: Source length; `None` for stills and until probed.

hash.description: Content hash (hex) used to relink moved files; `None` until computed.

tags.description: Free-form labels the user put on the item in the media bin (`docs/features/media-bin.md`), trimmed, unique, at most `MAX_TAGS`.

uri.description: Host-resolved locator: a path relative to the project, a file handle key (web) or similar. Opaque to the model.

Rational.description: An exact fraction (frame rates, speeds). `den` is always positive and the fraction is reduced.

background.description: What shows where no clip covers the canvas (TL-19, `docs/features/background.md`). Absent in older files = black.

loop_range.description: True while playback loops over `range` (needs a range). Absent = false.

markers.description: Markers and chapters (TL-07, M2-007, `docs/features/markers.md`), ordered by time then id. Absent in older files = none.

range.description: The in/out range (render range, loop range). `None` = the whole sequence. Absent in older files = none.

rate_fixed.description: Same for `frame_rate`: true once the user picked a frame rate; while false the first picture imported sets it.

size_fixed.description:
True once the user chose the canvas size (an aspect/size preset or a custom one). While false the first picture imported sets
`resolution` ("match first clip", the zero-question default). Absent in older files = false.

tracks.description: Bottom-to-top for video (later tracks draw over earlier ones). Any number of tracks of either kind.

Time.description: A point in time or a duration, in ticks. Serialized as a plain integer.

TimeRange.description: A half-open stretch of the timeline: `start <= t < end`, `0 <= start < end`.

colour.description: Label colour as `#rrggbb`; `None` = the theme's default for the kind. Schema 2.

height.description: Row height in UI pixels (`MIN_TRACK_HEIGHT..=MAX_TRACK_HEIGHT`); `None` = the view's default for the kind. Schema 2.

hidden.description: Out of the output entirely (eye off): neither drawn nor heard. Added in schema 2; absent = false.

muted.description: Silent (audio) / not drawn (video). The track keeps its clips and its place in the stack.

solo.description: While any track of a kind is soloed, only the soloed tracks of that kind are drawn / heard. Schema 2; absent = false.
